bio: Omakase is typically an intimate affair, but at Testu Sushi Bar, only three lucky diners are served at once by two young and talented chefs. This isn't a hipster hangout—there's nothing flashy or trendy about this simple yet tasteful spot. While you won't find gold flakes or caviar gilding the lily, you will discover exceptional quality. The meal begins with a quartet of cool openers including poached Spanish mackerel with mountain potato and seawood sauce; coins of tender octopus in soy-dashi; Japanese cherry trout with battera kelp; and firefly squid with creamy miso-vinaigrette. Nigiri is crafted with care, with standouts including aged-smoked goldeneye snapper, bigfin reef squid with yuzu, and creamy cutlass fish....
